name: Grover's
description: A tavern and wayhouse run by Grover that attracts diverse patrons, many abandoned by dueling planeswalkers.

description_citations.text: "Grover". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Around 4000 AR, Crookshank kobolds led by Dreadfang began frequenting Grover's and eating him out of everything.
timeline.quote: a bunch of Crookshank kobolds began frequenting Grover's and eating him out of everything

citation.text: "Grover", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyyrao Grrenmw snapped Dreadfang's neck, ending the spat with the kobolds.
timeline.quote: The spat temporarily ended when Kyyrao Grrenmw snapped Dreadfang's neck.

citation.text: "Grover", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A year later a reanimated Dreadfang captured Corsen Mon Duur's family and sent him to convince Loot Niptil to seek Anaytha.
timeline.quote: One year later, a reanimated Dreadfang captured Corsen Mon Duur

citation.text: "Grover", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grover gave Loot, Kyyrao and Shinra provisions for their trip to the Peregrinator Complex.
timeline.quote: Grover provided them with no words of wisdom, but did give them provisions for the trip.
